description: What batteries near a site actually earned from ERCOT's 60-day disclosure reports: energy revenue (DAM awards and prices for discharge/charge intervals), ancillary-service revenue by product (RegUp, RegDn, RRS, ECRS, Non-Spin with MCPC clearing prices), total $/MW-month, cycles per day, and discharge/charge patterns. Data covers the most recent ~60 days of disclosed settlements for every registered ESR (energy storage resource) in ERCOT. Use to benchmark realistic battery revenue at a location, compare energy vs AS revenue splits, identify high-performing batteries and their operating patterns, or validate a pro-forma against actual disclosed results. Each battery is mapped to its settlement point and (where matched) its EIA-860M plant record for nameplate MW and MWh. Best used with volatile_nodes (which nodes have the best spreads) and binding_constraints (which congestion drives those spreads).

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

limit.description: Max batteries to return. Default 20, max 50.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 50, max 150.

settlement_point.description: ERCOT settlement point name to find batteries at that node.

name: battery_performance
title: Realized battery revenue from ERCOT 60-day disclosure
